mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_execution (execution_id, session_id, agent_id, model_id, route_type, status, current_cycle, current_step, max_cycles, max_steps, state_json, last_assistant_content, error_message, started_at, completed_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{executionId}, #{sessionId}, #{agentId}, #{modelId}, #{routeType}, #{status}, #{currentCycle}, #{currentStep}, #{maxCycles}, #{maxSteps}, #{stateJson}, #{lastAssistantContent}, #{errorMessage}, #{startedAt}, #{completedAt}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM agent_execution WHERE execution_id=#{executionId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM agent_execution WHERE agent_id=#{agentId} AND session_id=#{sessionId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_execution SET current_cycle=#{currentCycle}, current_step=#{currentStep}, state_json=#{stateJson}, updated_at=NOW() WHERE execution_id=#{executionId} AND status='RUNNING'

UPDATE agent_execution SET status=#{status}, last_assistant_content=#{lastAssistantContent}, error_message=#{errorMessage}, completed_at=NOW(), updated_at=NOW() WHERE execution_id=#{executionId} AND status='RUNNING'
